Calm Cabin Care for Travelers

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps guidance clear, calm, and practical for every trip. Staff should confirm carrier fit, calm boarding paths, and steady communication before pets move through the cabin flow. <<FACT F053>> The ground team must keep movements gentle and predictable, with careful checks at each handoff.

Travelers benefit when the desk shares plain advice and sets expectations early. <<FACT F034>> With careful preparation, the cabin stays orderly, pets remain more settled, and every departure begins with good safety habits.
